d: Room with toilets, coffee table and books. Don Piastraone as a chamber study; Dori adorning himself in the mirror; Euphelia asking for various books, both served by their Homes.
Artemidoro, then Euphelia.
Dori and Don Gasperone, who come singing, without paying any attention to Euphelia and Artemidoro, who are sitting at the opposite side.
Don Piazzone and sayings.
Wood; at the bottom it is a rocky cliff, at the foot of which it is a wild cave with two entrances.
Madame Bartolina and Rubinetta both traveling; then Trophony returning.
Don Gasperone fleeing, then Artemidoro in the same way; then Madame Bartolina and Rubinetta.
Dori, then Don Gasperone in a philosopher's dress ridiculously loaded, with a book in his hand.
Artemidoro dancing from the cave, then Madame Bartolina and Rubinetta coming back, and sayings.
Dori, then Don Piazzone and Euphelia.
Trophony.
Don Piastraone, then Euphelia fleeing to Artemidoro looking for Eufelia.
Dori and said, then Euphelia.
Don Gasperone and Artemidoro from different roads, and sayings.
Trophony, then Madame Bartolina and Rubinetta don Gasperone and Artemidoro.
Euphelia and Dori aside, and sayings.
Don Plate and sayings; Trophony on the side.
Trophony coming forward unnoticed, and sayings.
Bosco with cave as in the first act. Madame Bartolina, Don Piastraone and Rubinetta, then Artemidoro in the background.
Madame Bartolina, then Trophony from the cave.
Room as in the first act. Euphelia reading with gravity, then Don Gasperone following, then Dori coming.
Dori and sayings.
Don Gasperone and Dori.
Artemidoro, and Euphelia with the same book in hand, and sayings.
Trophony in the form of a Plate, and sayings.
Trophony writing, then Rubinetta.
Don Gasperone, Artemidoro, Dori and Euphelia, indio Piastraone.
Don Piastraone, then Rubinetta.
Don Gasperone speaking to his Servant, and Piastraone.
Wood with cave as above. Trophony in its own form, then Dori and Euphelia.
Don Gasperone and Don Piastraone, who come out looking for the above mentioned women; Trophony inside, then Euphelia and Dori coming out of the opposite mouth of the cave.
Don Gasperone, Euphelia, then Artemidoro.
Room in the house of Don Piastraone. Don Piastraone thoughtful, then don Gasperone, then Trophonio from old shepherd.
Dori, then Euphelia, then Artemidoro.
Wood with cave. Trophony, Don Piastraone, Gasperone.
Wizard's Trophony, and sayings.
Euphelia, Dori and sayings.
Artemidoro, Don Gasperone and sayings.
Rubinetta, Madame Bartolina and sayings, then Trophony, Dori and Euphelia coming out of the cave.
